h01.label: perfect
h01.proof_summary: The reference returns the unique canonical bit representation of the mathematical sum. The mutant differs only when it drops a final carry, and every such output has the wrong value.

complete_witness.mutant_note: The first two cells of every row change by +1 and -1 while every row sum, audit cell, and return remain accepted.

h03.label: complete
h03.proof_summary: The three RotateTwo constraints fix post node order, payload order, and stamp order. The one-rotation mutant cannot satisfy them whenever its observable topology differs.

complete_witness.accepted_because: NumericEq equates signed zeros and flags are existential

complete_witness.candidate_note: Both are sorted permutations with a well-formed two-bit trace.
